This change touches no file under skills/ or packages/pi-legion; the job is not a required check, and dispatch://INFRA-376 fixes it.

The guard is a text match. It does not see a call split across lines so that "docker" is on the line after exec.CommandContext( (a probe in internal/bus passed it), or a command held in a variable. No exec call in packages/ is split that way today (grep finds none), so this is a limit of the guard, not a shape the module uses.
Two overlapping Freeze calls share one gate, so the first thaw resumes traffic for both; no caller freezes twice.
